title: DNA damage induces long range changes to duplex structure - a non-protein start to damage detection?
authors: Sophie E. Fountain; Mahmoud A. S. Abdelhamid; Timothy D. Craggs
one_liner_zh: 该文用单分子FRET实验研究DNA损伤引起的双链结构长程变化，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作背景但无AI/物理模拟方法，且未聚焦TF-DNA体系，仅对损伤识别机制有间接启发。
abstract: DNA-binding proteins must quickly locate specific sites on DNA to enable replication, repair, and transcription. While sequence-specific recognition is well understood, the physical basis of structure-specific recognition remains unclear, limiting our understanding of DNA damage repair. Proteins must distinguish damaged sites within largely undamaged DNA; however, studying this is challenging due to DNA’s dynamic nature. We hypothesised that DNA damage causes changes in DNA structure, signalling protein recruitment. Using confocal single-molecule FRET, we analysed seven DNA duplexes containing modifications such as ribonucleotide, 8-oxoguanine (8–oxoG), abasic sites, nicks, and gaps, which are all involved in the base excision repair (BER) pathway. Each construct was measured with nine dye pairs in triplicate to capture changes in bending, twisting, and stretching. An automated analysis pipeline processed 162 measurements, enabling rigorous statistical comparisons. All modifications altered FRET efficiencies compared to undamaged DNA, including the subtlest change: a single oxygen difference (ribo-vs deoxyribonucleotide). Abasic sites, nicks, and gaps had the greatest effects. These findings provide direct evidence that DNA damage affects duplex structure and dynamics beyond the lesion site, suggesting DNA flexibility changes may act as an early signal for repair protein recruitment. GRAPHICAL ABSTRACT
abstract_zh: DNA结合蛋白必须快速定位DNA上的特定位点，以实现复制、修复和转录。虽然序列特异性识别已被充分理解，但结构特异性识别的物理基础仍不清楚，这限制了我们对其在DNA损伤修复中作用的认识。蛋白质必须在大部分未受损的DNA中区分受损位点；然而，由于DNA的动态特性，研究这一过程具有挑战性。我们假设DNA损伤引起DNA结构的变化，从而发出蛋白质招募的信号。利用共聚焦单分子FRET，我们分析了七个含有核糖核苷酸、8-氧代鸟嘌呤（8–oxoG）、脱碱基位点、切口和缺口等修饰的DNA双链体，这些修饰均涉及碱基切除修复（BER）通路。每个构建体用九对染料进行三次重复测量，以捕捉弯曲、扭转和拉伸的变化。一个自动化分析流程处理了162次测量，实现了严格的统计比较。与未受损DNA相比，所有修饰均改变了FRET效率，包括最细微的变化：单个氧原子的差异（核糖核苷酸与脱氧核糖核苷酸）。脱碱基位点、切口和缺口的影响最大。这些发现提供了直接证据，表明DNA损伤影响双链体结构和动力学，且影响范围超出损伤位点，提示DNA柔性的变化可能作为修复蛋白招募的早期信号。图形摘要
